text:
alex.k: Heads up — partnership team wants to pilot an ISV sandbox we’re calling 'Sandcastle' to onboard LangChain / LlamaIndex adapters + gateway/orchestrator flows. Thinking 4-week pilot. Anyone available for a quick sync?

priya.r: Love it. What are success criteria? Fast onboarding + CI smoke tests + marketplace-ready artifacts?

sam.w: I can take infra. Need an isolated VPC, short-lived creds, and a prebuilt adapter template.

marie: Security checklist items: KMS integration, no external logs, RBAC for partner seats. @sam.w can you draft the infra template?

sam.w: On it. Drafting a quick manifest for discussion:
```
sandbox:
  name: sandcastle-isv-pilot
  adapters: [langchain, llamindex]
  gateway: redwood-gateway-v2
  network: vpc-ps-sandbox
  creds: ephemeral
```
Will iterate once we sync with partners.

jordan: Ops notes: autoscale off for pilot, quota 50k tokens/day per partner, and monitor latency closely (keep batching off to start).

alex.k: :thumbsup: Good calls. Partners for the first wave are FlowForge and ChainForge (cc @marie). We should validate Dedicated -> Private fallback paths as part of the pilot.

priya.r: Marketing wants co-branded docs + a joint blog. Can we produce a "how to onboard" with code samples in 2 weeks?

sam.w: 2 weeks is tight but doable for a minimal guide. Need partner signoff on sample prompts and eval sets.

dev-bot: deploy-bot: sandbox-alpha env created: sandcastle-alpha-1709123. Logs at https://internal.corp/logs/sandcastle-alpha

marie: Security review plan: block external log sinks, add KMS config and ephemeral key rotation, and run a quick threat model. Target review complete by EOD Wed.

alex.k: OK next steps: sam - infra PR by Tue; marie - security review Wed; priya - draft partner comms by Thu; I'll run partner kickoff Fri. Quick sync Fri 10am?

priya.r: I can do Fri 10.

sam.w: Works for me.

jordan: Booked.

marie: I'll be there. Adding checklist and action items to the shared doc: https://drive.redwood/sandcastle-checklist

alex.k: Thanks all — keeping this thread for async updates. Ping me here if any blockers come up.
